primaries.description: Higher engineering skill allows you to learn higher level engineering schematics.  Schematics can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
primaries.name: Engineering

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

specs.description:
A dark guardian who manipulates and corrupts life energy to sustain themselves in the face of an enemy onslaught.

Preferred Weapon: Two-Handed Axe, Mace, Sword
specs.name: Blood

specs.description:
An icy harbinger of doom, channeling runic power and delivering vicious weapon strikes.

Preferred Weapons: Dual Axes, Maces, Swords
specs.name: Frost

specs.description:
A master of death and decay, spreading infection and controlling undead minions to do their bidding.

Preferred Weapon: Two-Handed Axe, Mace, Sword

classTalents.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
classTalents.name: Icebound Fortitude

classTalents.description: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 4,346 Physical damage and heals you for 32.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 11.2% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Death Strike

classTalents.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
classTalents.name: Raise Dead

classTalents.description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
classTalents.name: Runic Attenuation

classTalents.description: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
classTalents.name: Improved Death Strike

classTalents.description: Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal 10% increased damage.
classTalents.name: Cleaving Strikes

classTalents.description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Mind Freeze

classTalents.description:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Blinding Sleet

classTalents.description: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
classTalents.name: Gloom Ward

classTalents.description:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 80% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
classTalents.name: Wraith Walk

classTalents.description: Increases Haste by 4%.
classTalents.name: Unholy Momentum

classTalents.description: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Enfeeble

classTalents.description: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.
classTalents.name: Proliferating Chill

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Veteran of the Third War

classTalents.description: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Brittle

classTalents.description: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
classTalents.name: Icy Talons

classTalents.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
classTalents.name: Anti-Magic Zone

classTalents.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
classTalents.name: Unholy Bond

classTalents.description: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Ice Prison

classTalents.description: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Asphyxiate

classTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
classTalents.name: Anti-Magic Barrier

classTalents.description: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
classTalents.name: Grip of the Dead

classTalents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Suppression

classTalents.description: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
classTalents.name: Unholy Endurance

classTalents.description: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.
classTalents.name: Osmosis

classTalents.description: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
classTalents.name: Runic Protection

classTalents.description:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 3,002 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
classTalents.name: Blood Draw

classTalents.description: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
classTalents.name: Rune Mastery

classTalents.description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
classTalents.name: Will of the Necropolis

classTalents.description: Magic damage taken is reduced by 5% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
classTalents.name: Null Magic

classTalents.description: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
classTalents.name: Death's Echo

heroTalents.description:
Your Death Coil, Epidemic and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 7.0% for 20 sec.
heroTalents.name: Vampiric Strike

heroTalents.description:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
heroTalents.name: Vampiric Speed

heroTalents.description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
heroTalents.name: Blood-Soaked Ground

heroTalents.description:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
heroTalents.name: Bloody Fortitude

heroTalents.description:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 0.2% per stack.

Dread Plague deals 20% and Virulent Plague deals 10% increased damage.
heroTalents.name: Thrill of Blood

heroTalents.description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and erupts them with 75% increased effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Infliction of Sorrow

heroTalents.description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
heroTalents.name: Frenzied Bloodthirst

heroTalents.description:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
heroTalents.name: The Blood is Life

heroTalents.description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
heroTalents.name: Visceral Strength

heroTalents.description:
Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.

Vampiric Strike grants maximum stacks of Clawing Shadows.
heroTalents.name: Inevitable

heroTalents.description:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 3% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Incite Terror

heroTalents.description: Your Death Coil, Epidemic and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
heroTalents.name: Sanguine Scent

heroTalents.description: Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Lesser Ghouls by 10% for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Transfusion

heroTalents.description:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 80%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
heroTalents.name: Gift of the San'layn

specTalents.description:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 23,377 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Explodes for 8,541 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 9,899 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
specTalents.name: Outbreak

specTalents.description:
An unholy strike that deals 6,437 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
specTalents.name: Scourge Strike

specTalents.description: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
specTalents.name: Sudden Doom

specTalents.description:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.
specTalents.name: Clawing Shadows

specTalents.description: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 8,403 Shadow damage and have them explode for 5,867 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
specTalents.name: Putrefy

specTalents.description:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Dark Transformation

specTalents.description: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.
specTalents.name: Foul Infections

specTalents.description: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 2,383 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
specTalents.name: Necromancer's Cunning

specTalents.description: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.
specTalents.name: Ebon Fever

specTalents.description:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 3,935 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.
specTalents.name: Festering Scythe

specTalents.description:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing 24,759 Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

Consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul stacks to summon them instantly.
specTalents.name: Soul Reaper

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Magus of the Dead

specTalents.description: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 681 Shadow damage over 9 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
specTalents.name: Infected Claws

specTalents.description:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Cycle of Death

specTalents.description: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.
specTalents.name: Coil of Devastation

specTalents.description:
Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

 Death Orders
Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 980 Shadow damage to your target.

 Epidemic Orders
Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 356 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
specTalents.name: Army of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.

Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.
specTalents.name: Reaping

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Ghoulish Frenzy

specTalents.description: Diseased enemies take 1% increased damage from you per disease they are affected by.
specTalents.name: Morbidity

specTalents.description:
Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.

Summoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Harbinger of Doom

specTalents.description:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Unholy Devotion

specTalents.description:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.
specTalents.name: Blightburst

specTalents.description: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.
specTalents.name: Putrid Echoes

specTalents.description: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Doomed Bidding

specTalents.description:
Magus of the Dead grants you 2.0% Haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Unholy Aura

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 20%.
specTalents.name: Commander of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.
specTalents.name: Lord of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 2,233 Shadow damage to the target and 1,542 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
specTalents.name: Outnumber

specTalents.description: Dread Plague has a 20% chance to rouse the dead, causing a Lesser Ghoul to unearth and leap at the target to Putrefy at 100% effectiveness.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specTalents.description:
Putrefy causes your next 1 Scourge Strike to summon a Lesser Ghoul, and grants you 6% Mastery for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specTalents.description:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 7,908 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 2,521 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 3,980 Shadow damage and 1,822 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specs.name: Unholy

pvpTalents.description: Shadowy tendrils constrict an enemy's throat, silencing them for 4 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Strangulate

pvpTalents.description:
Putrefy applies a Necrotic Wound to the enemy when it deals damage, absorbing 8% of all healing received for 15 sec.

Max 3 stacks. Adding a stack does not refresh the duration.
pvpTalents.name: Necrotic Wounds

pvpTalents.description: Anti-Magic Shell is now usable on allies and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Spellwarden

classTalents.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
classTalents.name: Raise Dead

classTalents.description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
classTalents.name: Runic Attenuation

classTalents.description: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
classTalents.name: Improved Death Strike

classTalents.description: Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal 10% increased damage.
classTalents.name: Cleaving Strikes

classTalents.description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Mind Freeze

classTalents.description:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Blinding Sleet

classTalents.description: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
classTalents.name: Gloom Ward

classTalents.description:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 80% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
classTalents.name: Wraith Walk

classTalents.description: Increases Haste by 4%.
classTalents.name: Unholy Momentum

classTalents.description: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Enfeeble

classTalents.description: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.
classTalents.name: Proliferating Chill

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Veteran of the Third War

classTalents.description: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Brittle

classTalents.description: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
classTalents.name: Icy Talons

classTalents.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
classTalents.name: Anti-Magic Zone

classTalents.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
classTalents.name: Unholy Bond

classTalents.description: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Ice Prison

classTalents.description: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
classTalents.name: Asphyxiate

classTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
classTalents.name: Anti-Magic Barrier

classTalents.description: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
classTalents.name: Grip of the Dead

classTalents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
classTalents.name: Suppression

classTalents.description: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
classTalents.name: Unholy Endurance

classTalents.description: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.
classTalents.name: Osmosis

classTalents.description: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
classTalents.name: Runic Protection

classTalents.description:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 3,002 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
classTalents.name: Blood Draw

classTalents.description: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
classTalents.name: Rune Mastery

classTalents.description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
classTalents.name: Will of the Necropolis

classTalents.description: Magic damage taken is reduced by 5% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
classTalents.name: Null Magic

classTalents.description: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
classTalents.name: Death's Echo

heroTalents.description:
Your Death Coil, Epidemic and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 7.0% for 20 sec.
heroTalents.name: Vampiric Strike

heroTalents.description:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
heroTalents.name: Vampiric Speed

heroTalents.description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
heroTalents.name: Blood-Soaked Ground

heroTalents.description:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
heroTalents.name: Bloody Fortitude

heroTalents.description:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 0.2% per stack.

Dread Plague deals 20% and Virulent Plague deals 10% increased damage.
heroTalents.name: Thrill of Blood

heroTalents.description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and erupts them with 75% increased effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Infliction of Sorrow

heroTalents.description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
heroTalents.name: Frenzied Bloodthirst

heroTalents.description:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
heroTalents.name: The Blood is Life

heroTalents.description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
heroTalents.name: Visceral Strength

heroTalents.description:
Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.

Vampiric Strike grants maximum stacks of Clawing Shadows.
heroTalents.name: Inevitable

heroTalents.description:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 3% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Incite Terror

heroTalents.description: Your Death Coil, Epidemic and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.
heroTalents.name: Sanguine Scent

heroTalents.description: Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Lesser Ghouls by 10% for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Transfusion

heroTalents.description:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 80%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
heroTalents.name: Gift of the San'layn

specTalents.description:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 23,377 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Explodes for 8,541 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 9,899 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
specTalents.name: Outbreak

specTalents.description:
An unholy strike that deals 6,437 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
specTalents.name: Scourge Strike

specTalents.description: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
specTalents.name: Sudden Doom

specTalents.description:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.
specTalents.name: Clawing Shadows

specTalents.description: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 8,403 Shadow damage and have them explode for 5,867 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
specTalents.name: Putrefy

specTalents.description:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Dark Transformation

specTalents.description: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.
specTalents.name: Foul Infections

specTalents.description: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 2,383 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
specTalents.name: Necromancer's Cunning

specTalents.description: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.
specTalents.name: Ebon Fever

specTalents.description:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 3,935 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.
specTalents.name: Festering Scythe

specTalents.description:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing 24,759 Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

Consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul stacks to summon them instantly.
specTalents.name: Soul Reaper

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Magus of the Dead

specTalents.description: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 681 Shadow damage over 9 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
specTalents.name: Infected Claws

specTalents.description:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Cycle of Death

specTalents.description: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.
specTalents.name: Coil of Devastation

specTalents.description:
Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

 Death Orders
Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 980 Shadow damage to your target.

 Epidemic Orders
Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 356 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
specTalents.name: Army of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.

Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.
specTalents.name: Reaping

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Ghoulish Frenzy

specTalents.description: Diseased enemies take 1% increased damage from you per disease they are affected by.
specTalents.name: Morbidity

specTalents.description:
Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.

Summoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Harbinger of Doom

specTalents.description:
Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Unholy Devotion

specTalents.description:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.
specTalents.name: Blightburst

specTalents.description: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.
specTalents.name: Putrid Echoes

specTalents.description: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Doomed Bidding

specTalents.description:
Magus of the Dead grants you 2.0% Haste for 15 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Unholy Aura

specTalents.description: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 20%.
specTalents.name: Commander of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.
specTalents.name: Lord of the Dead

specTalents.description:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 2,233 Shadow damage to the target and 1,542 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
specTalents.name: Outnumber

specTalents.description: Dread Plague has a 20% chance to rouse the dead, causing a Lesser Ghoul to unearth and leap at the target to Putrefy at 100% effectiveness.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specTalents.description:
Putrefy causes your next 1 Scourge Strike to summon a Lesser Ghoul, and grants you 6% Mastery for 12 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specTalents.description:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 7,908 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 2,521 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 3,980 Shadow damage and 1,822 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
specTalents.name: Forbidden Knowledge

specs.name: Unholy

pvpTalents.description: Shadowy tendrils constrict an enemy's throat, silencing them for 4 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Strangulate

pvpTalents.description:
Putrefy applies a Necrotic Wound to the enemy when it deals damage, absorbing 8% of all healing received for 15 sec.

Max 3 stacks. Adding a stack does not refresh the duration.
pvpTalents.name: Necrotic Wounds

pvpTalents.description: Anti-Magic Shell is now usable on allies and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Spellwarden

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

bossEncounters.description: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.
bossEncounters.name: Rav'i

bossEncounters.description: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.
bossEncounters.name: The Writhing Coil

bossEncounters.description: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gain the power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.
bossEncounters.name: Zul'jan

dungeon.description: Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only that cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orweyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.
dungeon.name: Altar of Fangs

bossEncounters.description: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.
bossEncounters.name: Kystia Manaheart

bossEncounters.description: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.
bossEncounters.name: Zaen Bladesorrow

bossEncounters.description: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.
bossEncounters.name: Xathuux the Annihilator

bossEncounters.description: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.
bossEncounters.name: Lithiel Cinderfury

dungeon.description: The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.
dungeon.name: Murder Row

bossEncounters.description: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.
bossEncounters.name: The Hoardmonger

bossEncounters.description: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.
bossEncounters.name: Sentinel of Winter

bossEncounters.description: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.
bossEncounters.name: Nalorakk

dungeon.description: Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.
dungeon.name: Den of Nalorakk

bossEncounters.description: The domanaar's prized champion, Taz'Rah, is forced to fight against his will. Taz'Rah demands his own death from every opponent, hoping each battle will finally end his suffering.
bossEncounters.name: Taz'Rah

bossEncounters.description: Imprisoned by Charonus, this starving behemoth is hoping for a new victim to sate his appetite. Atroxus's sheer size is almost as dangerous as the poison he spews.
bossEncounters.name: Atroxus

bossEncounters.description: The overly confident and ostentatious owner of the Voidscar Arena, Charonus, is impressed by the fighting ability of Azerothians and demands them for his grand collection.
bossEncounters.name: Charonus

dungeon.description: The Voidscar Arena awaits worthy challengers! Overseer Charonus has filled the arena with opponents plucked from across Azeroth, forcing them to participate in his games.
dungeon.name: Voidscar Arena

bossEncounters.description: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.
bossEncounters.name: Lightblossom Trinity

bossEncounters.description: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.
bossEncounters.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter

bossEncounters.description: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.
bossEncounters.name: Lightwarden Ruia

bossEncounters.description: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.
bossEncounters.name: Ziekket

dungeon.description:
The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake.
After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative. Growth unstoppable.
dungeon.name: The Blinding Vale

bossEncounters.description: Melidrussa Chillworn leads the Primalist infusion efforts in the Ruby Life Pools. Her fervent belief is that she is protecting young dragon eggs from the influence of the titans and cleansing them from the stain of Order magic. She will stop at nothing to fulfill her calling and return the eggs to what she believes is their natural state.
bossEncounters.name: Melidrussa Chillworn

bossEncounters.description: As Primalist forces assault the Ruby Life Pools from all sides, it falls to Kokia and her Blazebound lieutenants to capture precious eggs from overwhelmed defenders, all while spreading flame and havoc as they go.
bossEncounters.name: Kokia Blazehoof

bossEncounters.description: Kyrakka and Erkhart roam the skies above the Ruby Life Pools coordinating attacks on the shrine below, while also taking out any interfering dragons. If left unchecked, they will burn the Life Pools to the ground and blow the remaining ash away in a cleansing elemental storm.
bossEncounters.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein

dungeon.description:
As the ancestral nesting grounds for the five flights, the Ruby Life Pools is a sacred place. The Red Dragonflight, whose charge it is to nuture all life, protect these pools and the the future of all dragonkind held within them.

However, Raszageth and her Primalists have come to steal that future away and infuse their own powers into the sacred pools. They must be stopped for dragonkind to thrive.
dungeon.name: Ruby Life Pools

bossEncounters.description: A pair of powerful sethrak that are blessed by the storm and charged with guarding the temple's entrance.
bossEncounters.name: Adderis and Aspix

bossEncounters.description: Merektha is the product of foul experiments to produce an army of unstoppable beasts. With her clutch of eggs beginning to hatch, this mother is on the hunt for victims to serve as food for her ravenous children.
bossEncounters.name: Merektha

bossEncounters.description: With the corruption of her temple, Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals that roam the sunken chambers. Formed by this aberrant energy, Galvazzt seeks to grow in power by any means.
bossEncounters.name: Galvazzt

bossEncounters.description: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.
bossEncounters.name: Avatar of Sethraliss

dungeon.description: Centuries ago, Sethraliss, a powerful snake loa, sacrificed herself to stop Mythrax from unleashing his master upon Azeroth. After the battle, her devoted followers transported her remains and built a temple around them while they awaited her rebirth. Now, a dark force stirs within this sacred temple that seeks to twist her power towards nefarious ends.
dungeon.name: Temple of Sethraliss

bossEncounters.description: Kings' Rest has come under attack before. After a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer to this island many millennia ago, the priests of Zandalar created a mighty construct to defend this tomb. The Golden Serpent has stood against intruders ever since, judging who is worthy to enter these sacred halls.
bossEncounters.name: The Golden Serpent

bossEncounters.description: There was once a caste of Zandalari whose purpose was to preserve and defend the remains of past rulers. But when a terrible plague of corrupted blood tore through the empire, it was too risky for mortals to handle the dead. Golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial; they have been used ever since.
bossEncounters.name: Mchimba the Embalmer

bossEncounters.description: There was once a time when no single emperor could rule Zandalar. After a period of civil war, the heads of three families formed an uneasy coalition and tried to rule the empire together. Though they did not often agree, there was peace in Zandalar. Briefly.
bossEncounters.name: The Council of Tribes

bossEncounters.description:
Dazar. The founder and first King of Zandalar, who led an exodus of his people out of the muck and mire and built a city of gold. The first tamer of raptors. The warrior undefeated. The father of a kingdom.

His eternal repose cut short by Zul's dark magic, it lies to you to once again put him to rest.
bossEncounters.name: Dazar, The First King

dungeon.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.
dungeon.name: Kings' Rest
